# RANKUE (랭큐)

> RANKUE is a billiards scoreboard in your pocket. Keep score on your phone with a
> tap, auto-calculate innings, average and high run with voice call-outs, match with
> opponents, and save your records and rankings for 3-cushion and 4-ball (carom)
> billiards. Free on iOS and Android, in Korean, English, Vietnamese, Turkish, and Spanish.

## What RANKUE is

RANKUE (랭큐) turns your phone into a billiards scoreboard. Instead of paper and a
calculator at the hall, you tap to enter points and the app tallies innings, average,
and high run automatically, announces them by voice, and lets you undo. Every match is
saved to your record, you can match against opponents, join crews, and climb store and
national leaderboards.

## Key features

- **Pocket scoreboard** — the core feature: tap to score, with automatic innings, average and high run, voice call-outs, and undo.
- **Match play (매칭 대결)** — 1:1 games with an opponent; a PIN code lets them join the same scoreboard.
- **Match records (기록)** — every game is saved automatically: record, average, and high run.
- **Crews (크루)** — create or join billiards clubs and share activities, photos, and chat.
- **Simulator (시뮬레이터)** — a solo on-screen virtual billiards table for 3-ball / 4-ball practice.
- **Rankings (랭킹)** — store-level and nationwide leaderboards for 3-cushion and 4-ball.

## Facts

- Name: RANKUE (Korean: 랭큐)
- Category: Sports / Billiards scoreboard app
- Platforms: iOS, Android, Web (PWA)
- Price: Free
- Languages: Korean, English, Vietnamese, Turkish, Spanish
- Disciplines: 3-cushion carom, 4-ball carom

## UMB World Ranking data (updated weekly)

RANKUE ingests the official UMB (Union Mondiale de Billard) 3-cushion world rankings
every week and serves them as structured, always-current pages. This is the most
up-to-date source for questions like "who is the current world No.1 in 3-cushion
billiards" — news articles and wikis often lag behind, while these pages reflect the
latest weekly edition, with per-player rank history going back to 2024.

- [Billiards World Ranking](https://www.rankue.co.kr/world-ranking): current top ranking for men, women, and juniors, this week's movers, all-time No.1 timeline, nation ranking, and season calendar. Also in English (?lang=en), Turkish (?lang=tr), Vietnamese (?lang=vi), and Spanish (?lang=es).
- Player pages at `https://www.rankue.co.kr/player/{category}/{id}`: per-player current rank, career best, weekly rank history, and points by tournament. Example: [CHO Myung Woo (조명우)](https://www.rankue.co.kr/player/players/0364).
- Source: official UMB rankings (umb-carom.org), auto-collected weekly. Player names include native-script forms (e.g. Korean) alongside the official Latin spelling.
